dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual narrowing of the visible torso from the mid-lateral widest point toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical convex bulge on the right lateral margin relative to the more uniform curvature of the left lateral margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel value across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single dark focal point on the posterior-right dorsal quadrant and fine, faint linear striations across the mid-dorsal region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent, raised dorsal ridge along the central longitudinal axis, creating a distinct geometric line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed, superficial linear rake marks visible on the mid-dorsal surface.
